anchors.meaning: New game sets point1 to mode2 and explicit point/track hidden flags after loading the two raw tables.
Town reset clears100 records of264 bytes then calls the explicit tree initializer.
Initial roots/children are executable town-id/event-id calls, not ownership inferred from TOWNDEF comments.
Point event replacement writes+8; type flags replace other types and clear visited.
Money check subtracts on success; insufficient branch reaches dialogue before returning the failure phase.
Completed insufficient-money dialogue returns1 and clears the VM phase.
Secret-man slot index selects a signed16-bit event from the literal source table.
Starting a route sets walker speed to16.16 value0x20000 before the animation tick.
Arrival reads mutable point event/type; previously visited battle selects a0..2 level offset.
Arrival either requests an event/level or enters the selected town, then marks visited.
Point initialization applies the separate OBS visual type to the base frame and sets32-pixel hit bounds.
Music getter uses signed track table and current level for argument-1.

limits: Original instruction execution with synthetic pointer/phase inputs, not a Wine gameplay run.
Insufficient money stops before creating dialogue; its completed phase is checked separately.
Default menu initialization does not infer later script-modified menus or full world presentation.
